question: Who formulated the Equation E = mc² ?
solution:
Correct answer is__** Albert Einstein.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• According to scientific folklore, **Albert Einstein** formulated this equation in 1905.
 
• "**Energy equals mass times the speed of light squared**." 
 
• Albert Einstein was **a Theoretical Physicist of German origin**.
 
• He is the one who **developed a pillar of modern Physics**, the Theory of Relativity.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/275e6989513ee968849f74a4233c90070e53fec622cb20a1ee467b6399868fec.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Isaac Newton **was an **English physicist and mathematician**, who was the culminating figure of the **Scientific Revolution of the 17th century.****​ **
 
• Stephen Hawking was **a famous cosmologist, physicist, and professor**.
 
• Marie Curie was a **physicist, chemist and pioneer in the study of radiation**.
